_about: Carp streamers (koinobori) on a tall bamboo pole in the village in late spring (KoinoboriRules; the 3D view KoinoboriProps, the flat view KoinoboriView; the pictures KoiArt). A 'koinobori' map prop (data/maps/town.json: on the grass in front of Kota's house, south-west of the road, clear of every path, door and spawn) stands on a small stone socket all year; the pole, the spinning wheel, the fukinagashi streamer and the three carp go up only on `days` of `season` between `hours`, and come down in the weather of `wet` (a prop may carry its own `season`, `days` and `hours`). The wind of data/wind.json (Game.wind_strength) fills them: the effective wind is the day's strength times a slow gust swing of `gust` x (1 - the strength), so a sunny breeze of 0.15 swings between nothing and about twice that while a gale hardly gusts, `calm` and `full` are the effective winds at which a carp is limp and wholly filled, and the fill is cut at `levels` (limp hanging, half filled and slanting, full and streaming); a carp flaps its tail `flap` times a second (base + fill x gain), the wheel turns `wheel` periods a second (base + effective wind x gain) through `frames` pictures. The pictures change `rate` times a second in both views. Heights are in picture pixels above the pole's foot (the 3D view takes them at FarmWorld.PX a pixel). Carp are drawn by KoiArt from `length`, `radius` and the tones lit from the upper left (light, base, dark) and a belly. Balance and colours are ours.
